text.content: CWAM B5 VOM R7 policy-ranking formal 20k

Train the R7 architecture long enough to determine whether its preregistered causal dependence on aligned object-memory history remains stable and yields a viable checkpoint for closed-loop RoboCasa365 evaluation.

Complete 20,000 finite optimizer steps on 8 B200s; save complete model/optim/scheduler/trainer DCP checkpoints every 1,000 steps; retain finite action gradients and nonzero memory contribution; at final matched validation, aligned main-action loss is at least 1% below both exact-zero and shuffled memory. Closed-loop success remains a separate terminal evaluation gate.

Fresh formal run from R4 model-only checkpoint; no R7 optimizer/scheduler resume; R6-A dynamic-exclusive full final-delta architecture; complete strong_action_expert train scope; R7 aligned/zero/shuffle policy ranking weight=1.0, relative margin=1%, rank warmup=50; 20,000 steps; LR warmup=500/cycle=20,000; batch 64/rank, DP8, global 512; validation every 500; DCP every 1,000.
RoboCasa365 B4 processed split plus 1,143,698-record triple-view Wan latent cache and episode-safe t-36/t-24/t-12 visual-history sidecar; same stream and data contract as R7; no future lookup.
pyrogpucompute1; 8 x NVIDIA B200 183359 MiB; batch 64/rank; effective global batch 512.

Optimizer step/time and total loss; aligned/zero/shuffle main action losses and relative gains; ranking loss and violation fractions; main contribution RMS/ratio; slot diversity and contrastive margins; action-gradient validity; GPU utilization/memory/power; checkpoint completeness.

This is a new 20,000-step confirmatory training run from the same R4 model-only warm start used by R7. The completed 500-step R7 checkpoint authorizes the objective but is not resumed, so the formal optimizer, scheduler, data stream, and LR schedule start independently at step zero. Every 500 steps the same-forward paired intervention metrics are evaluated; every 1,000 steps a full 8-rank DCP snapshot is retained.
